name: gn-call-generic
old:
(defn- gn-call-generic [M :vector-i64 i :i64 f :i64 t :i64 n :i64] :vector-i64
 (cond
         (and (<= n 7) (= (gn-op M (inc i)) OP-RET) (= (gn-sir M (inc i) IF-A) t))
         (gn-op-tail-call M f t n)
         :else
    (-> M
      (gn-save 0 t)
      (gn-stack-args t 7 n)
      (gn-args t 0 (gn-min n 7))
      (gn-ctx)
      (gn-fix FX-BL26 f)
      (gn-emit (enc-bl 0))
      (gn-vclear)
      (gn-gs gn-f-ctx (if (>= (gn-ctx-safe M f n 8 512) 0) 1 0))
      (gn-take i t 0))))

name: gn-loop

name: gn-run-open
old:
(defn- gn-run-open [M :vector-i64 first :i64 count :i64] :vector-i64
  (let [top (vector-at M MM-HEAP-TOP)
        M0 (if (< top MM-HEAP-BASE) (gn-put M MM-HEAP-TOP MM-HEAP-BASE) M)
        M1 (mem-alloc M0 (+ gn-a-lp MM-LABEL-CAP 80))
        M2 (-> (gn-put M1 gn-cell (vector-at M1 MM-R0))

        M3 (if (= (vector-at M2 MM-ERR) 0) (gn-loop M2 1) M2)
